headers.comment: Fingerprinted build output is immutable — cache it for a year.
The HTML entry must always be revalidated or deploys never land.
Allows Unsplash imagery, Google Fonts and the Maps embed; blocks everything else.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; frame-src https://www.google.com https://maps.google.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; object-src 'none'
